text:
The judge should sustain the company’s objection and exclude the deposition. It is hearsay offered to prove structural defects, and the former-testimony exception fails because the company lacked a similar motive in the wrongful-termination case to develop that defect testimony, even though the engineer is unavailable. It is also not a party-opponent admission, since he spoke after his employment ended, and it is not a statement against his own interest.

CONFIDENCE: 72
